description: Revert to the most stable and highest-performing baseline configuration (8 layers, 128 head dim, 128 batch size, 0% warmup, 0.06 Matrix LR, softcap 13) to re-establish the 0.9878 baseline, as recent attempts to fine-tune the learning rate or architecture have consistently yielded worse results (0.9880+), indicating the current local optimum is robust and further exploration requires a different strategy rather than marginal tweaks.
